_doc: Overrides for scripts/update-prices.mjs. price_url: page to check instead of tool.price_url/source. extra_sources: additional OFFICIAL vendor URLs (count as independent sources). data_fixes: one-time data corrections applied only when publishing (DRY_RUN=false), and only if the current value equals 'from'. converted: tools whose stored USD is converted from a local currency (manual check only). render_clicks: exact visible labels Playwright clicks before reading the rendered page (tabs only, never sign-in or consent bypass).
